name: RF and Microwave Measurement Laboratory
description: Laboratory experiments including network analyzer, spectrum analyzer, anechoic chamber, analog-to-digital signal conversion – Nyquist sampling, quantization, uniform and logarithmic quantizer, signal analysis – time and frequency domain signal characterization, filtering, SNR calculation, audio beamforming, signal stationarity measurement, semiconductor carrier type and mobility measurement, FET DC characterization, sensor and system analysis.
